questions.stem: A 3-year-old girl is brought in by her mother due to failure to thrive and easy fatigability. Examination reveals severe anemia, splenomegaly, and jaundice. The patient's family history includes an unspecified "blood problem." Hemoglobin electrophoresis is normal, and a complete blood count (CBC) shows normocytic anemia. Peripheral blood smear demonstrates numerous abnormal erythrocytes, including spiculated cells. Given these findings and the presence of an enzyme deficiency leading to anemia, what is the most common enzyme deficiency associated with this presentation?
